products.promise_scale.derivation: get_account and create_promise both use integer cents, so promise_scale equals amount_scale (100) and is left unset.

products.promise_round.assumption: Amounts are exact cents and floors are whole dollars; no rounding to the promise unit is needed.

multi.outcome_priority.assumption: No ranking; the engine default applies (promise, else paid if all paid, else the first product's ending).

assumptions: Amounts arrive in cents (amount_scale 100). create_promise also takes cents, so promise_scale stays unset (same as amount_scale).

CARD floor order: 12% of the overdue amount in dollars, then rounded up to the whole dollar (already whole stays as it is), then max with $35, then clamped to the overdue amount if the overdue amount is below $35. Checks: $412.50 gives 49.50, floored at $50; $300.00 gives exactly $36; $250.00 gives 30, so the floor is $35; $20.00 owed gives a floor of $20.00.

AUTO band 1 floor = monthly_payment_cents (capped at the overdue amount by the engine). AUTO band 2 floor = the full overdue amount (floor_full_types [AUTO]), so its step 2 equals step 1 and is skipped without using an attempt.

Rule 9 (CARD band 2) is modelled as last_business_day_of_month with roll_if_not_after_today. When today is the month's last business day, the deadline becomes next month's last business day; for example, Mon 2026-11-30 gives Thu 2026-12-31. A call after the last business day (a month-end weekend) also rolls, since a past deadline is impossible.
Deadlines checked for Sunday 2026-10-11: CARD band 1 (7th business day) = 2026-10-20; AUTO band 1 (3rd) = 2026-10-14; AUTO band 2 (2nd) = 2026-10-13; CARD band 2 = 2026-10-30.
Band 1 has one attempt (step 1: full amount on the deadline); band 2 has two (step 2: the floor on the deadline). The opening question is not counted.
days_past_due outside 1–75 is in no band. The brief gives no rule, so the default (service_error) applies.
The brief gives no callback window, callback days or number of asks. Defaults are used: today or the next business day, 10:00–19:00, after now, 2 asks.
The brief does not state confirm attempts, max_not_talk, the 'next Friday' interpretation or the unclear-answer limit. Defaults are used.
The hardship event code is XFER/care with note HARDSHIP. Hardship is transferred directly to CARE and no note is written on a transfer (notes_before_transfer false).
No identity hints are relevant (no date questions), so hints is empty. Unreadable answers return ok=false and are not counted as wrong answers.
If a promise write fails twice, the account gets note SYSTEM. The call closes NO_PTP/system unless another promise was recorded (engine built-in).
The optional add_note 'text' field is not mapped. The optional result_reason is mapped and left empty for PTP_SET and PAID_CLAIM.
The brief gives no read-out line after a recorded promise, so sms_line is empty.
